items.title: Kitchen installation appointment
items.quote: Unser Montageteam kommt am Samstag, 19.09.2026, um 07:30 Uhr und braucht voraussichtlich den ganzen Tag.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date and time for the installation team's visit: Saturday, 19.09.2026, 07:30. No counting or delivery-deeming rule applies; the date is taken as printed.

items.title: Empty the kitchen and make water/power connections accessible before the team arrives
items.quote: Bitte räumen Sie die Küche vorher vollständig aus und sorgen Sie dafür, dass die Wasser- und Stromanschlüsse zugänglich sind.
items.computation: The letter asks that this be done 'vorher' (beforehand), i.e. before the installation team's arrival at 07:30 on Saturday 19.09.2026. No separate calendar date is given, so the latest moment this can be done is immediately before the 07:30 start on the appointment day itself (in practice the evening before is advisable).

items.title: Notify the company if the installation date does not work
items.quote: Ist der Termin für Sie nicht möglich, melden Sie sich bitte bis Mittwoch der Montagewoche.
items.computation: The installation ('Montage') is scheduled for Saturday 19.09.2026. The 'Montagewoche' (installation week) is the calendar week containing that Saturday, i.e. Monday 14.09.2026 to Sunday 20.09.2026. 'Mittwoch der Montagewoche' is therefore Wednesday 16.09.2026. This is a plain calendar-week reference stated by the company, not a statutory period, so no BGB counting or weekend/holiday shift rule applies.
